title: UnmaskSecurityEvent
description: A single privacy-safe browser security event ingested by the UNMASK backend. Contains only metadata about a suspicious behavior, never plaintext secret values.

event_id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for the event. Any client-supplied value is ignored.

incident_id.description: Optional incident to attach this event to. If omitted, the server groups the event automatically.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

tab_id.description: Browser tab identifier the event was observed in.

field_type.description: Classification of the form field involved (e.g. 'password', 'creditCard'). This is a category label, never the actual field value.

script_origin.description: Origin of the script responsible for the observed behavior.

destination.description: Destination host/origin data was observed being sent to, if any.

policy.description: Policy or rule that was evaluated against this event.

action.description: Action taken as a result of the event (e.g. 'OBSERVED', 'BLOCKED', 'ALLOWED').

metadata.description: Freeform additional context. Must never contain plaintext secrets.
